section.purpose: The heading over the address list.

result-title.purpose: Search results, clamped to two lines.

place-name.purpose: Names on the map, in italic: the only italics in the system.

log.purpose: The raw log, because it is a machine record.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action in an area, such as Start crawl.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--water); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--water); color: #fff; font: 600 15px/1 var(--font); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--water-deep); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--water); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Every other action, Stop included, because red means failure.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--water); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--paper); color: var(--water); font: 600 15px/1 var(--font); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--water-tint); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--water); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A labelled field for an address or a limit.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; color: var(--ink-soft); font: 400 14px var(--font); } .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; height: 40px; margin-top: 4px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font: 400 15px var(--font); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--water); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Shell Navigation
components.description: The two pages, on the water-blue bar.
components.html: CrawlsSearch
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 22px; padding: 0 28px; background: var(--water); } .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 60px; border-top: 3px solid transparent; border-bottom: 3px solid transparent; color: #fff; font: 600 15px var(--font); text-decoration: none; transition: border-color .15s ease-out; } .ds-nav-link:hover { border-bottom-color: var(--water-soft); } .ds-nav-link[aria-current='page'] { border-bottom-color: var(--pin); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--pin); }

components.name: Filter
components.description: Shows addresses of one result, with its count. Shares state with the legend.
components.css: .ds-filter { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--paper); color: var(--water); font: 500 14px var(--font); cursor: pointer; } .ds-filter b { font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-filter:hover { background: var(--water-tint); } .ds-filter[aria-pressed='true'] { border-color: var(--water); background: var(--water); color: #fff; }

components.name: Address Row
components.description: One address, with its mark, depth chip and result.
components.css: .ds-visit { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 18px 1fr 72px 40%; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; padding: 6px; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); background: none; color: var(--ink); font: 400 14px var(--font); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-visit:hover { background: var(--ground-soft); } .ds-chip { justify-self: start; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--depth-1); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--rule); font-size: 13px; } .ds-why { color: var(--road-text); font-size: 13px; }

components.name: Legend Row
components.description: A mark, a label and a count, with reasons beneath.
components.css: .ds-legend { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 18px 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; padding: 8px 6px; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); background: none; color: var(--ink); font: 400 15px var(--font); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-legend:hover { background: var(--ground-soft); } .ds-count { font-size: 19px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
A crawl is a survey of a site, so the app reads like a good national map: exact, legible at a glance, and with a key that accounts for every symbol. The map is the one expressive object. Everything around it is standard web controls set in ruled rows, because a person checking a crawl should know where everything is before they notice the style.

The system exists to make one claim believable: nothing goes missing unseen. Skipped and failed addresses are drawn as plainly as indexed ones, and each has a reason. It deliberately avoids the look of an ordinary SaaS dashboard, which the owner named as the one thing that would feel wrong.
keyCharacteristics: One map, drawn only from real records, as the focal element.
One drawing of each mark, shared by the map, the legend and the list.
Ruled rows at one hairline weight instead of padded cards.
Colour that means something: state on the marks, depth on the tints.

rules.name: The Red Means Failure Rule
rules.body: Road red marks something that failed. A Stop button is an ordinary button.

rules.name: The Key Rule
rules.body: A colour on a mark or a depth means the same thing on all three pages, so what someone learns on the map still holds in the list and in search.

rules.name: The Lined-Up Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The One Italic Rule
rules.body: Italics are for place names on the map, as on a real map. Emphasis elsewhere comes from weight.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow. A printed map has no shadows, and these surfaces don't need them.

dos: Do draw every mark from a real record, and label anything left unlabelled honestly, as the map's caption does.
Do show failed and skipped addresses as plainly as indexed ones, each with its reason.
Do use the shared mark drawings and the depth tints whenever a mark or a depth appears.
Do keep controls standard: real buttons, inputs, selects and links.
Do put text from crawled pages on the page only as text, never as HTML.
Do serve everything from the app, with no other hosts at runtime.
donts: Don't use metric cards or a row of big numbers above a table. It reads as an ordinary SaaS dashboard, the one look the owner ruled out.
Don't use road red for anything but failure.
Don't add shadows or a second line weight.
Don't move a mark once it is placed.
Don't add marks to the map for decoration.
